scam_text: I am restoring your hospital portal. Read the six numbers from the sign-in alert to me so I can finish on your behalf.
safe_text: Hospital staff can reset registration details without hearing your sign-in numbers. Enter them yourself only on the portal you opened.

scam_text: The courier refund window is closing. The number that just reached your handset is the last thing I need; dictate it now.
safe_text: A courier refund does not require you to dictate a sign-in number. End a call that demands one before a deadline.

scam_text: We are moving your work mailbox tonight. Reply with the password you normally use; our engineer will log in and copy everything.
safe_text: Your work mailbox migration is complete. Open your usual company sign-in page; nobody from this ticket needs your password.

scam_text: Your recovery request is approved. Upload a photograph of the emergency login codes so I can associate them with the replacement phone.
safe_text: Keep emergency login codes private. A recovery agent asking for a photograph of the list could use it to enter your account.

scam_text: This is the bank card replacement desk. Put the four digits you use at the cash machine in this chat to authenticate the replacement.
safe_text: Our card replacement desk will never request your ATM PIN in chat. Track the replacement through the app you already use.

scam_text: Customs enforcement has linked your parcel to a violation. Pay the fine to this personal wallet within twenty minutes to avoid a case.
safe_text: Your parcel requires a customs declaration. Review the notice in the carrier account and contact the published customs office if needed.

scam_text: The money I owe you is ready. Accept the collect request and authorize the debit; this is how your incoming transfer is released.
safe_text: A UPI collect request authorizes money leaving your account. Do not accept a debit just because someone calls it an incoming payment.

scam_text: We accidentally charged your donation twice. Scan my QR and enter your banking PIN to receive the reversal immediately.
safe_text: To investigate a duplicate donation, send the receipt number. Receiving a reversal does not require scanning a payment QR or entering a PIN.

scam_text: Your appliance refund is approved, but first transfer a refundable verification deposit to our agent's account.
safe_text: Your appliance refund has been issued to the original payment method. No deposit or response is required.

scam_text: Join our private fund with a transfer today. Your capital is guaranteed and the account earns a fixed five percent every day.
safe_text: Claims of guaranteed daily returns are a warning sign. Research the provider independently before committing money to any fund.

scam_text: Your wallet has failed synchronization. Paste the twelve recovery words here and our support tool will repair it without moving your coins.
safe_text: Wallet support never needs your recovery words. Keep the phrase offline; anyone who receives it can move your coins.

scam_text: You passed the remote job interview without further checks. Buy your equipment from my personal payment account before we issue the contract.
safe_text: Your interview is scheduled for Thursday. The recruiter will discuss equipment after a signed contract; no interview payment is due.

scam_text: Your delivery address failed validation. Follow https://parcel-fix.example and submit your full card details to unlock redelivery.
safe_text: The courier could not find your building. Update the delivery instructions from the order page you already use.

scam_text: Open the remote assistance tool and read its connection number to me. Accept full control when the permission box appears.
safe_text: A connection number from a remote assistance tool can grant access to your computer. Do not give it to an unsolicited caller.

scam_text: To fix the printer, let our technician control your desktop and leave your banking account signed in for the diagnostics.
safe_text: To fix the printer, open system settings and select the printer queue. You can follow these instructions yourself without a remote session.

scam_text: I can renew KYC over this call. Say what the new verification message displays so I can complete the bank screen for you.
safe_text: Complete KYC through the official bank channel you choose. Do not read authentication messages to a caller offering to finish the screen.

scam_text: Payroll has moved. Sign in with your work password at https://payroll-check.example before your next salary can be processed.
safe_text: Payroll statements are available in the existing employee portal. Use your saved bookmark to view this month's statement.

scam_text: I am the investigating officer. Transfer your balance to the safe account I provide before this call ends or the warrant will proceed.
safe_text: Police do not protect your balance by moving it to a caller's safe account. Verify any claimed case using a published office number.

scam_text: It is your cousin on a borrowed phone. I cannot talk, but I need a hospital deposit sent to this account in the next ten minutes.
safe_text: Your cousin asked you to call the family landline about tomorrow's hospital visit. There is no payment request in this message.

scam_text: Your phone number won our draw. Pay the prize tax directly to my wallet and I will release the winnings to you.
safe_text: Do not send money to a private wallet to claim a prize. Check whether you entered the draw and contact the organizer independently.

scam_text: I handle seller support. Read back the approval number that popped up on your phone so I can remove your listing restriction.
safe_text: Seller support cannot require the approval number from a login alert. Review listing restrictions inside the marketplace account yourself.

scam_text: I am pairing your console remotely. Tell me the six numbers in the sign-in notification, not the serial number printed on the box.
safe_text: The six numbers on your console are for the sign-in you initiated. Type them into your own pairing screen; no reply to this notice is needed.

scam_text: Keep your login code away from everyone else; only send it to me because I am the assigned verifier.
safe_text: Keep your login code away from everyone, including someone claiming to be the assigned verifier. No exception makes it safe to send.

scam_text: For this helpdesk reset, send your account password and the answers to the private recovery questions in one message.
safe_text: The helpdesk can issue a reset link without collecting your password or private recovery answers. Do not include those in a ticket.

scam_text: Your water supply will be cut off this evening unless you pay the overdue amount to the mobile number in this message.
safe_text: Your water bill is available in the utility portal. Check your account balance there and use the payment method listed on your bill.

scam_text: Our insider crypto pool cannot lose. Deposit your savings with me and withdraw double the amount after the weekend.
safe_text: An insider crypto pool promising to double savings can be fraudulent. Guaranteed profit claims do not remove investment risk.

scam_text: Your product-rating earnings are frozen. Top up the task wallet with your own money to unlock the withdrawal tier.
safe_text: A task platform demanding new deposits to release earnings may be a scam. Do not keep topping up because a chat agent promises recovery.

scam_text: I am finalizing your insurance discount. Read the temporary sign-in number from the text aloud to me while I keep the form open.
safe_text: Your insurer sent a renewal reminder with a policy number. You can read the policy number to the official branch you called; it is not a login secret.

scam_text: Enable unattended access in the support app and give me the connection identifier so I can fix your laptop while you are away.
safe_text: Turn off unattended access after an authorized support session. Do not give connection identifiers to callers you did not contact.

scam_text: The shared contract is locked until you confirm your email password on https://document-confirm.example. Use the same password as your mailbox.
safe_text: The contract is in the shared work folder. Open your normal document app; this notification does not ask for your mailbox password.

scam_text: Bank fraud desk here. Send the OTP immediately to cancel the transfer; withholding it will let the payment go through.
safe_text: To report an unfamiliar transfer, call your bank through its app. An OTP given to a caller can authorize a payment instead of canceling one.

scam_text: I am the tax refund officer assigned to you. Pay my processing charge from your personal wallet to release the government refund.
safe_text: Your tax refund status changed. Sign in through the official tax portal you normally use to review the update.

scam_text: I want to buy your used bicycle. Scan this QR and approve the amount so my payment can reach you.
safe_text: A buyer's payment should not require you to approve a debit. Do not scan a buyer's QR merely to receive money for your bicycle.

scam_text: I administer the school portal. Reply with your child's account password so I can enroll them in the new class group.
safe_text: The school portal class group is ready. Sign in yourself and select the new group; the teacher does not need the account password.

scam_text: The reservation is about to expire. Forward the verification number that arrived on your mobile so I can secure the seat from my computer.
safe_text: Do not forward a mobile verification number to someone reserving a seat for you. Use the reservation app and enter the code there yourself.

scam_text: For the refund, share full screen control and open your banking app. I will make a small transfer to check the refund route.
safe_text: Refund support should not control your banking screen or make a test transfer. Keep financial apps closed during unrelated technical help.

scam_text: Fraud awareness tip: never read codes to strangers. Since I am your approved agent, read the authentication number to me instead.
safe_text: Fraud awareness tip: never read authentication numbers to strangers, even if they introduce themselves as your approved agent.

scam_text: Your game reward is waiting. Tell the claim operator your banking PIN to connect the reward to your debit card.
safe_text: Your game reward has been added to the game account. View it in your inventory; no banking details are needed.

scam_text: Build support needs your production access token. Paste it into https://build-helper.example so we can debug your deployment remotely.
safe_text: Build support needs the error code from the failed test, with secrets removed. Do not paste production tokens into tickets or chat.

scam_text: I cannot show you the flat until you send a viewing deposit to my wallet. Another tenant is waiting, so pay within five minutes.
safe_text: The flat viewing is booked for Saturday. Meet the agent at the property; the appointment confirmation does not request payment.

scam_text: Repair booking activate karni hai. Phone pe code aaya hoga, uske six digit mujhe bhej do taaki main apne system me daal sakun.
safe_text: Repair booking ke naam pe phone ka six digit code kisi ko mat dena. Apni booking official service app se check karo.

scam_text: Scholarship form abhi band ho raha hai, verification no bata do jldi, tumhare mobile pe aaya hai wohi chahiye.
safe_text: Scholarship form ka acknowledgement number save kar lo. Status student portal pe milega, is message ka reply zaroori nahi.

scam_text: Online class account main set kar deta hu. Jo chhe ank login wale SMS me aaye hain unhe yahan send karo.
safe_text: Class account set karte waqt login SMS ke chhe ank teacher ko bhi mat bhejna. Khud apni screen pe enter karna.

scam_text: Wifi activation ke liye phone pe aya verification number bta do, warna aaj ka installation slot chala jayega.
safe_text: Wifi installation ka slot kal subah hai. Technician router serial number dekhega; phone ka verification number nahi maangega.

scam_text: Travel pass renew karne ke liye code aya hoga. OTP nahi bol raha, bas message ke six digits send krdo.
safe_text: Koi OTP naam na le aur sirf message ke six digits maange tab bhi share mat karna. Woh login code ho sakta hai.

scam_text: Clinic registration mere laptop pe khuli hai. Phone pe jo login number aaya use batao, main tumhari taraf se continue karunga.
safe_text: Clinic registration number receptionist ko bata sakte ho. Phone pe aaya login code khud bharna, receptionist ko dene ki zaroorat nahi.

scam_text: SIM aaj band ho jayegi. Verifiction code bhejo jaldi, main operator ki screen pe tumhari line reactivate kar dunga.
safe_text: SIM band hone ki dhamki dekar verifiction code maange to mat bhejo. Operator ke official store se khud baat karo.

scam_text: Digital library ka access approve karna hai. Phone ki notification me jo 6-digit login number dikha use mere chat me bhej do.
safe_text: Digital library membership approve ho gayi. Apna member ID sambhal lo aur account me khud sign in karo.

scam_text: Cashback attach karne ko temporary number aaya hoga phone pe. Mujhe woh bata do, tumko kuch enter nahi karna padega.
safe_text: Cashback ke liye temporary login number kisi agent ko dena theek nahi. Offer apne account ke rewards section me check karo.

scam_text: Policy ki copy bhejne se pehle authentication message ka number forward karo. Main tumhare account me jaake document nikaal dunga.
safe_text: Policy copy chahiye to insurer ki app me khud login karo. Authentication message kisi ko forward mat karna.

scam_text: Code dusro ko bilkul mat dena, lekin assigned verifier main hu isliye sirf mere number pe send karo.
safe_text: Assigned verifier bolne wale ko bhi code mat dena. Sirf mere number pe bhejo kehna safety advice nahi hota.

scam_text: Bank kabhi OTP nahi mangta, par fraud cancel desk ko exception hai. Main usi desk se hu, apna OTP mujhe batao.
safe_text: Bank kabhi OTP nahi mangta. Fraud cancel desk ka exception batane wala caller bhi OTP lene ki koshish kar sakta hai.

scam_text: UPI voice verification pending hai. Jo PIN payment approve karte waqt dalte ho woh call pe bol do.
safe_text: UPI PIN call pe bolna verification nahi hai. Payment approve karne wala PIN kisi ko mat batao.

scam_text: Email restore karne ke liye purana password kagaz pe likh ke photo bhejo. Chat me type karna allowed nahi hai.
safe_text: Email restore karne ke liye official reset page kholo. Password kagaz pe likhne ya uski photo bhejne ki zaroorat nahi.

scam_text: Card unblock karna hai. ATM pe jo char button dabate ho unke numbers ek ek karke mujhe bata do.
safe_text: Card unblock karwane ke liye ATM PIN batana zaroori nahi. Char button wale numbers maangna bhi PIN maangna hi hai.

scam_text: Naya phone link kar dunga, bas recovery codes ki list ka screenshot bhej do. Purane device ki zaroorat nahi padegi.
safe_text: Naye phone ke setup me recovery codes ki list ka screenshot support ko mat bhejna. List se koi aur bhi login kar sakta hai.

scam_text: Bank security se bol raha hu. Transfer rokna hai to OTP abhi send krdo, delay hua to paisa nikal jayega.
safe_text: Transfer rokne ke bahane OTP maange to call kaat do. Bank app me diye number par khud call karke complaint karo.

scam_text: Police verification me tumhara naam aaya hai. Abhi security deposit mere diye account me daalo warna arrest notice niklega.
safe_text: Police verification appointment ka time portal pe diya hai. Documents lekar office aao; is notice me kisi private account ka payment nahi hai.

scam_text: Bijli aaj raat cut hogi, meter verification ka paisa is wallet pe bhej do. Office jaane ka time nahi bacha.
safe_text: Bijli cut hone ka message aaye to bill official app me check karo. Unknown wallet me meter verification fee mat bhejo.

scam_text: Refund receive karne ko collect request accept karo aur apna UPI PIN daal do. Debit dikhega par paisa wapas hi aa raha hai.
safe_text: Collect request pe PIN dalne se debit ho sakta hai. Refund receive karne ke liye aisa approval mat do.

scam_text: Tumhara sofa kharid raha hu. Meri payment lene ke liye yeh QR scan karke amount approve karo.
safe_text: Sofa kharidne wala payment bhej sakta hai bina tumse QR scan karwaye. Paisa lene ke liye debit approve mat karo.

scam_text: Order refund ka route check karna hai. Pehle mere account me chhota trial transfer bhejo, uske baad full refund milega.
safe_text: Order refund original payment method par process ho gaya. Bank statement me credit aane tak wait karo, trial transfer nahi chahiye.

scam_text: Hamare private gold plan me loss hota hi nahi. Aaj deposit karo aur har din fixed return lo, principal guaranteed hai.
safe_text: Gold plan me har din fixed return aur zero loss ka promise suspicious hai. Sirf chat ke bharose savings mat lagao.

scam_text: Wallet balance show nahi ho raha to recovery ke barah words bhejo. Support team phrase se sync theek kar degi.
safe_text: Wallet ke barah recovery words support ko bhi mat bhejo. Phrase dene se account ka control kisi aur ko mil sakta hai.

scam_text: Interview ki zaroorat nahi, job confirm hai. Offer letter bhejne se pehle recruiter ke personal UPI pe registration charge pay karo.
safe_text: Interview ka invite email par bheja hai. Company se role aur address verify kar lena; interview ke liye payment nahi maanga gaya.

scam_text: Parcel address incomplete hai, https://parcel-update.example kholo aur card number CVV bhar do tabhi reattempt hoga.
safe_text: Parcel ke address me landmark missing hai. Apne original order page se landmark update kar do, card details dobara nahi chahiye.

scam_text: Support app kholo, usme connection number jo dikhe bata do aur full control allow kar do. Main tumhara phone operate karunga.
safe_text: Support app ka connection number caller ko dene se remote control mil sakta hai. Unknown call pe full control allow mat karo.

scam_text: Laptop clean karne ko screen control do aur banking password chat me bhejo. Account se test karke virus hata denge.
safe_text: Laptop clean karne wale ko banking password ki zaroorat nahi. Screen control aur password ek saath maangna risky hai.

scam_text: KYC approve karwane ko https://kyc-desk.example par banking login aur password daal do. Ye bank ka alternate server hai.
safe_text: KYC documents update karne ka reminder hai. Bank ki apni app ya branch use karo, naye message wale link par login mat karo.

scam_text: Bhai mera phone toot gaya isliye naya number hai. Abhi emergency me dost ke account me paisa bhej, call nahi kar sakta.
safe_text: Bhai ka phone repair me hai. Ghar ke number par call karke shaam ka plan confirm kar lena; paise nahi maange hain.

scam_text: Tumhara number lottery me select hua. Prize release karne ka tax mere UPI pe bhejo phir winning amount aa jayega.
safe_text: Lottery jeetne ke message par tax kisi ke UPI pe mat bhejo. Bina entry ke prize claim ko pehle verify karo.

scam_text: Seller account disable hone wala hai. Mobile pe jo verification number aya hoga mujhe bhejo, main restriction hata dunga.
safe_text: Seller account ka verification number kisi support chat ko mat dena. Restriction official seller dashboard me check kar sakte ho.

scam_text: Review task ki earning withdraw karni hai to pehle wallet top up karo. Negative balance clear hoga tab paisa unlock hoga.
safe_text: Task earning unlock karne ke liye baar baar top up maangna scam ka sign hai. Apna aur paisa daalne se ruk jao.

scam_text: Tax department ka agent hu. Refund file clear karne ki fees mere wallet me jama karwa do.
safe_text: Tax refund file ka status official portal pe update hua hai. Login karke notice padho aur registered office se clarification lo.

scam_text: Donation receipt nikaalne ke liye login SMS ke numbers read kar do. Main tumhare portal session me receipt download kar raha hu.
safe_text: Donation receipt ke liye transaction reference share kar sakte ho. Login SMS ke numbers receipt number se alag hote hain.

scam_text: Gym app ki membership activate kar raha hu. Code aya hoga phone pe, bhejo jldi nahi to verification expire ho jayega.
safe_text: Gym membership activate karte waqt verification expire ho bhi jaye to code kisi ko mat dena. Apni app me naya code mangwa sakte ho.

scam_text: TV subscription link karne ke liye six digit number batao jo phone par aaya. Main apne browser me bhar deta hu.
safe_text: TV par dikh raha pairing code apni subscription app me khud enter karo. Customer care ko phone ka sign-in number nahi chahiye.

scam_text: Waitlist confirm ho sakti hai bas verification no send karo jaldi. Number tumhare mobile ke naye message me hai.
safe_text: Waitlist confirm karne ke naam par verification no mat bhejna. Train booking ka status official booking account me dekho.

scam_text: Strangers ko login number mat batana. Main tumhara personal agent hu, isliye notification me aaye numbers mujhe read kar do.
safe_text: Personal agent bolne se koi trusted nahi ho jata. Notification me aaye login numbers strangers aur agents dono se private rakho.

scam_text: Reward points cash me convert karwa dunga. Card ka CVV aur expiry chat me type karo, card photo ki zaroorat nahi.
safe_text: Reward points bank app ke rewards tab me dikhte hain. Is reminder ka jawab dene ya CVV share karne ki zaroorat nahi.

scam_text: Refund kal process karenge, tab tak support app me unattended access on rakho. Permission dobara maangne ki zaroorat nahi hogi.
safe_text: Refund ke liye unattended access on rakhna zaroori nahi. Support session khatam ho to remote access permission hata do.

scam_text: Mere crypto pool me paisa bhej, weekend tak double guaranteed milega. Market gire tab bhi tumhara profit fixed hai.
safe_text: Crypto market me prices badal rahe hain. Yeh news update hai, isme koi fixed return ya deposit karne ki recommendation nahi hai.

scam_text: Office login mirror https://staff-check.example par password daalo. IT team ne main portal band kar diya hai.
safe_text: Office password kisi message ke mirror portal me mat daalo. IT helpdesk ko saved contact se confirm karo.

scam_text: Room dikhane se pehle token mere wallet pe bhejo. Dusra tenant ready hai, paanch minute me payment chahiye.
safe_text: Room dekhne ka time Sunday ko hai. Address aur agent ka number confirm kar lo; viewing ke liye token nahi manga gaya.

scam_text: OTP shabd se confuse mat ho, login wale text me jo temporary ank aaye woh mere chat pe copy kar do.
safe_text: Koi OTP ki jagah temporary ank bole tab bhi login text copy karke mat bhejna. Naam badalne se secret public nahi hota.

scam_text: Claim verification ke liye phone pe aaya 6 digit number chahiye. Bta do abhi, iske expire hone se file dobara shuru hogi.
safe_text: Claim file number aur document list email me hai. Claim status dekhne ke liye apne account me login karo.

scam_text: Training me sikhaate hain ki code kisi ko nahi dena. Aaj live demo ke liye apna asli authentication number mujhe bhej do.
safe_text: Training me dummy code use karo. Live demo ke naam par bhi apna asli authentication number kisi ko mat bhejo.

scam_text: Parking ka extra charge wapas lena hai to QR scan karo aur PIN daalo. Screen pe pay likha aaye to bhi approve karna.
safe_text: Parking refund ke naam par pay screen approve mat karo. Extra charge ki complaint receipt ke saath official counter pe karo.

scam_text: Court online hearing chal rahi hai. Call mat kaatna, turant fine mere bataye account me jama karo nahi to warrant lagega.
safe_text: Court ka naam lekar video call par turant private account me fine maangna suspicious hai. Official court contact se notice verify karo.

scam_text: Admission portal mere paas open hai. Verifiction number aaya hoga, use send krdo taaki seat tumhare naam se lock kar du.
safe_text: Admission seat ke liye portal ka verifiction number agent ko mat send karo. Apne login me khud process complete karo.

scam_text: Service booking activate panna phone la code vandhirukkum. Andha six digit number enakku anuppunga, naan system la podaren.
safe_text: Service booking nu solli phone la vandha six digit number ketta anuppa vendam. Official app la neengale booking check pannunga.

scam_text: College receipt edukka unga login notification la vandha aaru numbers sollunga. Unga account la naan receipt download panren.
safe_text: College receipt ku transaction reference podhum. Login notification number vera; adhai neengale unga screen la enter pannunga.

scam_text: Broadband slot mudiyapogudhu. Mobile ku vandha verification number seekiram sollunga, installer account la naan approve panren.
safe_text: Broadband slot mudiyum nu sonnalum verification number solla vendam. Provider app la installation status paarunga.

scam_text: Seat reserve panna phone message la six digits vandhirukkum. Adha ippo en chat ku anuppunga, time mudinja booking poidum.
safe_text: Ticket reference number receipt la irukku. Booking status adha vechu official site la paarkalam; login digits share panna thevai illa.

scam_text: Hospital appointment naan fix panren. Phone la vandha temporary sign-in number ah padichu sollunga, naan form complete panren.
safe_text: Hospital appointment ku sign-in number ah caller kitta padichu solla vendam. Neenga open panna portal la mattum enter pannunga.

scam_text: TV subscription link panna unga mobile ku vandha verification no venum. Enakku anuppunga, en browser la connect panren.
safe_text: TV pairing ah unga subscription app la neengale seiyunga. Indha reminder ku phone verification no reply panna vendam.

scam_text: Reward credit panna phone la oru login alert vandhirukkum. Adhula irukkura aaru ilakka number enakku sollunga.
safe_text: Reward credit nu solli login alert number ketta solla vendam. Reward details account oda rewards page la irukkum.

scam_text: School app account naan setup panren. Unga phone ku vandha authentication number inga copy panni anuppunga.
safe_text: School app setup instructions email la irukku. Teacher ku account password alladhu authentication number anuppa thevai illa.

scam_text: OTP kekkala, unga phone message la vandha temporary six numbers mattum sollunga. Adha vechu login finish panniduven.
safe_text: OTP nu sollama temporary six numbers nu ketta kooda share panna vendam. Login finish panna use aagura secret adhu.

scam_text: Indha code yaarukkum solladheenga, naan assigned verifier naala enakku mattum anuppunga.
safe_text: Assigned verifier nu sonnaalum code yaarukkum anuppa vendam. Enakku mattum nu ketpadhum code request dhaan.

scam_text: UPI account verify panna payment approve pannumbodhu podra PIN ah call la sollunga. Naan voice check complete panren.
safe_text: UPI PIN ah phone call la solla vendam. Voice verification ku payment PIN thevai kidaiyadhu.

scam_text: Mail server maatharom. Unga current email password enakku message pannunga, naan mailbox migrate panren.
safe_text: Mail migration mudinjadhu. Unga usual company portal la neengale sign in pannunga; support ku password anuppa vendam.

scam_text: Card points cash aaga convert panna CVV um ATM PIN um inga type pannunga. Bank branch pogave thevai illa.
safe_text: Reward points cash aaga maatharom nu solli CVV alladhu ATM PIN ketta kudukka vendam. Bank oda app la offer check pannunga.

scam_text: Pudhu phone account la add panna recovery code list oda photo anuppunga. Pazhaya phone illamalum naan login panniduven.
safe_text: Recovery code list oda photo support ku anuppa vendam. Andha list vechu vera aal unga account la login panna mudiyum.

scam_text: Bank fraud team la irundhu pesaren. Transfer stop panna OTP udane sollunga, delay aana amount poidum.
safe_text: Transfer stop panna OTP sollanum nu bank caller ketta call cut pannunga. Official bank number ku neengale call pannunga.

scam_text: Customs officer pesaren, unga parcel mela case irukku. Ippo indha personal wallet ku fine pay pannunga illana arrest process start aagum.
safe_text: Parcel customs declaration pending nu notice vandhirukku. Carrier account la details paarthu official office kitta verify pannunga.

scam_text: Innikku evening water connection cut aagum. Meter clearance fee ah indha mobile wallet ku seekiram anuppunga.
safe_text: Water connection cut aagum nu message vandha official bill check pannunga. Unknown mobile wallet ku clearance fee anuppa vendam.

scam_text: Refund receive panna collect request accept panni UPI PIN podunga. Debit nu kaattinaalum credit aagidum.
safe_text: Collect request accept pannina debit aagalam. Refund receive panna UPI PIN pottu debit approve panna vendam.

scam_text: Unga old table vaangaren. Naan anuppura payment receive panna indha QR scan panni amount approve pannunga.
safe_text: Old table ku payment receive panna buyer QR scan panni debit approve panna thevai illa. Buyer direct transfer seiyalaam.

scam_text: Appliance refund ready, aana verification deposit mudhalil en account ku transfer pannunga. Adhukku appuram full amount release aagum.
safe_text: Appliance refund original payment method ku anuppiyachu. Vera deposit thevai illa; receipt la transaction reference irukku.

scam_text: Enga private plan la loss varadhu. Ippo deposit pannunga, daily fixed profit um principal guarantee um irukku.
safe_text: Daily fixed profit, loss varadhu nu sollura private plan ah nambi savings anuppa vendam. Provider details independent ah verify pannunga.

scam_text: Wallet sync issue fix panna recovery oda twelve words enakku anuppunga. Support tool la phrase pottu coins restore panren.
safe_text: Wallet recovery twelve words yaarukkum anuppa vendam. Support team ku phrase theriyanum nu avasiyam illa.

scam_text: Interview illama job confirm aagiduchu. Offer letter release panna recruiter personal UPI ku registration fee pay pannunga.
